name: Windows LAPS
expectedDescription: Entra backup; 20-character random passwords with four character classes; seven-day rotation; reset and log off the managed administrator 24 hours after use.
manualInstructions: Enable and verify the Entra LAPS tenant prerequisite through the reviewed EntraLapsService prerequisite operation. Manages the built-in administrator by SID; does not enable or create an account. After use, reset its password and log off its sessions after 24 hours. Check conflicting LAPS GPO/CSP settings and test password escrow/retrieval before assignment.
